title: Independent thermodynamic test of two Ir(III)-salen-NHC isomers
difficulty_reasons: The two molecular endpoints and observables are fixed; the Agent mainly selects and validates a defensible comparative free-energy protocol.

paper.title: Cyclometalated iridium(III)–Salen NHC complexes: Gibbs energy–driven isomer distribution, structures, and Photophysical properties

data.description: Two complete XYZ coordinate files for the labeled neutral singlet molecular endpoints complex_1 and complex_2.
